The left pan shows its handle extending upwards; the right pan is cropped at the top. The lighting creates highlights on the metal rack and the rims of the pans.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture inside the pans is somewhat uniform and 'noisy' rather than showing distinct machining marks or natural seasoning variations. It looks slightly like generated noise rather than physical micro-surface detail.
The connection between the handle and the pan body is slightly soft/blurred. In real cast iron, this junction is usually sharp and distinct. Here it bleeds slightly into the background.
The wire rack bars seem to warp slightly and lose definition as they recede. Some intersections of the wires look fused or unclear, lacking precise geometric consistency.
